role_note: This exact locus and mechanism are used in AlphaGenome's official TAL1 tutorial and paper. It may validate the instrumentation, but it must not be reported as independent biological validation or novelty.

locus.description: Non-coding insertion upstream of TAL1 that creates a MYB-dependent neo-enhancer.

variant.coordinate_convention: VCF-like 1-based position, as accepted by alphagenome.data.genome.Variant

reference_validation.method: UCSC getData sequence API on hg38

ontology_terms.name: common myeloid progenitor, CD34-positive
ontology_terms.note: Matches the official AlphaGenome tutorial. It is not the T-ALL/Jurkat context in which the mechanism was established experimentally.

model_context.interval_rule: Center a supported-length interval on the variant; ensure the TAL1 promoter and gene body remain in the scored interval.

expected_outputs.track_selector: MYB when a compatible track exists

interpretability_targets: Input attribution and in-silico mutagenesis should localize to the inserted MYB motif.
Patching or ablation should support a motif-to-local-enhancer-to-TAL1-output path rather than a global activation artifact.
controls: Length-matched insertions that do not create a MYB motif.
Matched interventions in unrelated internal components and unrelated output tracks.

sources.supports: Exact Patient_3-5 variant, ontology term, sequence length, predicted output directions and the tooling example.
Somatic insertions create MYB motifs, recruit enhancer machinery and increase TAL1 expression; perturbing the mutant site collapses the enhancer.
Experimental genomic tracks from the TAL1 neo-enhancer study.
